Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 131: January 2012
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #131 shipped to subscribers in December 2011 (bearing the cover date of January 2012 for Issue 131). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #131 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

SSX (arcade snowboarding)
Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm Generations (3D fighting)
Ridge Racer Unbounded (arcade racing)
Trials Evolution (Xbox Live Arcade physics bike platformer)
Bloodforge (Xbox Live Arcade hack-and-slash action)
Sine Mora (Xbox Live Arcade side-scrolling shoot 'em up)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for Halo 4, Max Payne 3, BioShock Infinite, and Borderlands 2, alongside OXM's 2012 Most Wanted awards, monthly Review Roundup, and Top Plays segment.
